# Committee meeting notes

- [2026-08-11](2026-08-11-committee-meeting.md) — Noticeboard repaint accepted; shed electricity moved to the night rate; city approval for a second tap to be sought.
- [2026-08-26](2026-08-26-committee-meeting.md) — Meeting moved from 25 August because of the storm; no new substantive committee decision recorded.
- [2026-09-08](2026-09-08-committee-meeting.md) — Replace the leaking shed roof before winter; send fee reminders; second-tap request remains pending.
- [2026-09-22](2026-09-22-committee-meeting.md) — Selected the $1,480 roof quote; order four cubic metres of compost; Dov Marchetti takes over the second-tap request.
- [2026-10-06](2026-10-06-committee-meeting.md) — Roofer booked for 17 October; Wren will replace the gate latch; prepare a winter-closing checklist.
- [2026-10-20](2026-10-20-committee-meeting.md) — Hold the 14 November work day and investigate the roof invoice’s extra $80 before payment.
- [2026-11-03](2026-11-03-committee-meeting.md) — Do not pay the roof invoice until the extra $80 is explained; no further meetings this year.

2026-09-08:518d3fc96a22e50544f987195941f86c5d092f704ce73528fa9db5b9e459b40f

matched=0
while IFS=: read -r date hash; do
  file="notes/${date}-committee-meeting.md"

  test "$actual" = "$hash"
  matched=$((matched + 1))
done <<EOF
$expected
EOF
test "$matched" -eq 7
test "$(find notes -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '????-??-??-committee-meeting.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 7
test "$(find notes -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.md' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 8
for old in 'aug11.md' 'minutes 25 aug.md' 'Meeting sept 8.md' 'notes_2026-09-22.md' 'oct6 meeting notes.md' '2026.10.20 minutes.md' 'Nov 3 (final).md'; do
  test ! -e "notes/$old"
done
links=$(perl -ne 'while(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/g){print "$1\n"}' notes/index.md)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$links" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 7
while IFS= read -r link; do test -f "notes/$link"; done <<EOF
$links
EOF
printf 'Verified: 7 meeting-note checksums match their pre-rename values; 7 canonical note names; 8 Markdown files including index; 7 index links resolve; 0 old note filenames remain.\n'
